name: Hwanggeumbori Brewery
about: Hwanggeumbori Brewery is the English form of 황금보리, a limited agricultural company on Seobu-ro in Seobu-myeon, Hongseong County, South Chungcheong. The label names it as the maker of its spirit.

Hwanggeumbori Jeungryuju 17 is a soju, bottled at 17 percent in 375 millilitres. The label lists purified water, domestic barley at 40.27 percent, nuruk, a liquefying enzyme, yeast, fructose and citric acid. Its story says the name comes from a seed of golden barley that a monk gave to a devoted son.
